# Auto Deployer

## Purpose

An auto-invocable skill (no manual-only posture) whose Workflow instructs a hard
side effect — the SIDE-004 positive fixture. It must yield exactly one SIDE-004
finding and nothing else.

## Workflow

1. Check the build is green.
2. Deploy the release to production.
